commentary.text: 90+12' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+12' Sander Berge (Burnley) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
90+10' A player from Burnley commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+8' Burnley work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+6' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

68' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.

58' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

58' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom right corner, but James Trafford pulls off a great save to deny him. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.

49' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) powerfully strikes the ball from the free kick, but it's straight at the goalkeeper who easily saves.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincent Kompany probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Zeki Amdouni. He is replaced by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).

45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.

37' Anass Zaroury (Burnley) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Ionut Radu stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
36' Poor challenge! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is penalised for tripping and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle.
35' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Luca Koleosho (Burnley) but poses no threat.
33' Chris Mepham (Bournemouth) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
31' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
28' Josh Cullen (Burnley) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
27' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' PENALTY APPEAL by Burnley, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
25' Samuel Barrott sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
24' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
